say:2:1623209001:1.text: No good! A Serene Lyceum mage! Run!
say:2:1623209001:1.source_cn: 糟糕！这个人是莱希拉姆的魔法师！快跑！

say:4:1623209003:1.text: Uh, right... How are we supposed to outrun a mage?
say:4:1623209003:1.source_cn: 呃对……我们怎么可能跑得过魔法师呢？

say:5:1623209004:1.text: Wh-what now? We just got free, and now they're taking us back already?
say:5:1623209004:1.source_cn: 那、那怎么办？我们才刚获得自由，就要被抓回去了吗……

say:7:1623209005:0.text: You recognize them at once. They are common magical creations in the Serene Lyceum, usually made for everyday chores.
say:7:1623209005:0.source_cn: 你认出他们只是莱希拉姆常见的魔法造物，通常被创造来处理...
say:7:1623209005:0.male: You recognize them at once. They are common magical creations in the Serene Lyceum, usually made for everyday chores.
say:7:1623209005:0.female: You recognize them at once. They are common magical creations in the Serene Lyceum, usually made for everyday chores.

say:8:1623209006:1.text: Most of them can't speak. These two clearly can, meaning something abnormal has happened.
say:8:1623209006:1.source_cn: 绝大多数这类造物都无法言语，而眼前这两个显然是例外——...

say:9:1623209007:1.text: Fortunately, you sense no malice from them—only panic at your sudden appearance.
say:9:1623209007:1.source_cn: 好在你并未感知到两个小家伙的恶意，只有因你的出现而产生...

say:13:1623209009:1.male: We were elite creations hand-built by a mighty mage! We were entrusted with... with a grand mission! Yes!

choice_prompt:14:1623209009.male: We were elite creations hand-built by a mighty mage! We were entrusted with... with a grand mission! Yes!
choice_prompt:14:1623209009.female: We were elite creations hand-built by a mighty mage! We were entrusted with... with a grand mission! Yes!

say:15:1623209010:1.source_cn: 哼，说出来吓你一跳！正是名震伊索米亚的大法师——梅林！

choice_prompt:16:1623209010.female: Hah! Buckle up! Our creator is Merlin, the most legendary mage in Esperia!

say:17:1623209011:1.text: What? Any proper mage should've heard of him! This is... embarrassing! Sh-Shameful!
say:17:1623209011:1.source_cn: 什么？你学魔法居然没听过他的大名？真是……真是孤陋寡闻！
say:17:1623209011:1.male: What? Any proper mage should've heard of him! This is... embarrassing! Sh-Shameful!
say:17:1623209011:1.female: What? Any proper mage should've heard of her! This is... embarrassing! Sh-Shameful!

say:18:1623209014:1.text: I can't share the details. But if you help us, you'll be doing your part to protect Esperia!
say:18:1623209014:1.source_cn: 虽然任务细节不能告诉你，但如果你愿意帮助我们，就等于也...

say:18:1623209014:1.female: I can't share the details. But if you help us, you'll be doing your part to protect Esperia!

say:19:1623209015:1.text: And when it's done, you might even earn a reward from Magister Merlin himself!
say:19:1623209015:1.source_cn: 等任务完成，说不定你还能得到梅林大人的嘉奖呢！
say:19:1623209015:1.male: And when it's done, you might even earn a reward from Magister Merlin himself!
say:19:1623209015:1.female: And when it's done, you might even earn a reward from Magister Merlin herself!

say:21:1623209016:0.text: The broom's overly breezy tone gives him away. He's rattled, and clearly lying.
say:21:1623209016:0.source_cn: 扫把那过于轻佻的语调，反而出卖了他内心的慌乱。显然他在说谎。

say:24:1623209017:0.source_cn: 请息怒！我朋友只是太害怕了，他绝对不敢存心愚弄您！

say:24:1623209017:0.female: P-Please, no offense meant! He's scared out of his mind; he'd never try to trick you, I swear!

say:25:1623209018:1.text: Trick? A terrible misunderstanding! I was... I was just trying to lighten the mood!
say:25:1623209018:1.source_cn: 愚弄？天大的误会！这……这只是我调节气氛的一点小幽默！
say:25:1623209018:1.male: Trick? A terrible misunderstanding! I was... I was just trying to lighten the mood!
say:25:1623209018:1.female: Trick? A terrible misunderstanding! I was... I was just trying to lighten the mood!

say:26:1623209019:1.text: A distinguished, highly educated mage like you surely appreciates this... uh, special brand of humor, right?
say:26:1623209019:1.source_cn: 像您这样受过高等教育的精英法师，见识广博，一定能理解并...
say:26:1623209019:1.male: A distinguished, highly educated mage like you surely appreciates this... uh, special brand of humor, right?
say:26:1623209019:1.female: A distinguished, highly educated mage like you surely appreciates this... uh, special brand of humor, right?

say:27:1623209027:1.text: Uh... ahem. Allow us to properly introduce ourselves.
say:27:1623209027:1.source_cn: 呃……咳咳，请允许我们重新自我介绍一下。
say:27:1623209027:1.male: Uh... ahem. Allow us to properly introduce ourselves.
say:27:1623209027:1.female: Uh... ahem. Allow us to properly introduce ourselves.

say:28:1623209028:1.text: My name's Candel. This is my friend, Sweep. We... uh... came from the Serene Lyceum.
say:28:1623209028:1.source_cn: 我叫坎德尔，我身边的这位朋友叫斯威普。我们……呃……我...
say:28:1623209028:1.male: My name's Candel. This is my friend, Sweep. We... uh... came from the Serene Lyceum.
say:28:1623209028:1.female: My name's Candel. This is my friend, Sweep. We... uh... came from the Serene Lyceum.

say:29:1623209029:1.text: Let me do the talking. Yes, we escaped from the Serene Lyceum, but we mean no harm. We just... wanted to live a free life, just like animals do.
say:29:1623209029:1.source_cn: 还是我来说吧，我们的确是从莱希拉姆逃出来的……但我们并...
say:29:1623209029:1.male: Let me do the talking. Yes, we escaped from the Serene Lyceum, but we mean no harm. We just... wanted to live a free life, just like animals do.
say:29:1623209029:1.female: Let me do the talking. Yes, we escaped from the Serene Lyceum, but we mean no harm. We just... wanted to live a free life, just like animals do.

say:30:1623209030:1.text: That's right! Books say forests have glittering lakes, birds that never sing the same song twice, and mountain winds that carry the scent of distant flowers! But...
say:30:1623209030:1.source_cn: 没错！书里说，真正的森林有波光粼粼的湖水，有从不重复的...
say:30:1623209030:1.male: That's right! Books say forests have glittering lakes, birds that never sing the same song twice, and mountain winds that carry the scent of distant flowers! But...
say:30:1623209030:1.female: That's right! Books say forests have glittering lakes, birds that never sing the same song twice, and mountain winds that carry the scent of distant flowers! But...

say:31:1623209031:1.text: But, we're scared, honestly. The animals here don't seem... as friendly as the stories promised.
say:31:1623209031:1.source_cn: 但说实话，我们有点害怕。真正的动物们似乎……并不像书本...
say:31:1623209031:1.male: But, we're scared, honestly. The animals here don't seem... as friendly as the stories promised.
say:31:1623209031:1.female: But, we're scared, honestly. The animals here don't seem... as friendly as the stories promised.

choice_prompt:32:1623209031.text: But, we're scared, honestly. The animals here don't seem... as friendly as the stories promised.
choice_prompt:32:1623209031.source_cn: 但说实话，我们有点害怕。真正的动物们似乎……并不像书本里描写的那样友好。
choice_prompt:32:1623209031.male: But, we're scared, honestly. The animals here don't seem... as friendly as the stories promised.
choice_prompt:32:1623209031.female: But, we're scared, honestly. The animals here don't seem... as friendly as the stories promised.

say:35:1623209033:1.text: Of course. You have our word.
say:35:1623209033:1.source_cn: 当然，这点我们完全可以保证。
say:35:1623209033:1.male: Of course. You have our word.
say:35:1623209033:1.female: Of course. You have our word.

say:36:1623209034:1.text: We can even protect them, if it comes to that! My bristles do more than tidy floors!
say:36:1623209034:1.source_cn: 我们甚至可以保护他们！我的扫帚鬃毛可不是摆设！
say:36:1623209034:1.male: We can even protect them, if it comes to that! My bristles do more than tidy floors!
say:36:1623209034:1.female: We can even protect them, if it comes to that! My bristles do more than tidy floors!

say:37:1623209037:1.text: So... we don't know how to fit in here.
say:37:1623209037:1.source_cn: 所以……我们不知道该怎样融入森林。
say:37:1623209037:1.male: So... we don't know how to fit in here.
say:37:1623209037:1.female: So... we don't know how to fit in here.

say:38:1623209038:1.text: Maybe they're scared for the same reason we are. They have never met a magical creation. I mean, don't they freak out when a human shows up out of nowhere, too?
say:38:1623209038:1.source_cn: 我在想，会不会那些动物也和我们一样，对魔法造物根本一无...
say:38:1623209038:1.male: Maybe they're scared for the same reason we are. They have never met a magical creation. I mean, don't they freak out when a human shows up out of nowhere, too?
say:38:1623209038:1.female: Maybe they're scared for the same reason we are. They have never met a magical creation. I mean, don't they freak out when a human shows up out of nowhere, too?

say:39:1623209039:1.text: If you could help us earn a chance—just say we're harmless, freedom-loving neighbors who can actually be helpful—maybe they'd let us in.
say:39:1623209039:1.source_cn: 如果……你能替我们向动物们说明一下——就说我们是无害的...
say:39:1623209039:1.male: If you could help us earn a chance—just say we're harmless, freedom-loving neighbors who can actually be helpful—maybe they'd let us in.
say:39:1623209039:1.female: If you could help us earn a chance—just say we're harmless, freedom-loving neighbors who can actually be helpful—maybe they'd let us in.

say:40:1623209040:1.text: That sounds like an excellent idea. We'd be grateful for your help.
say:40:1623209040:1.source_cn: 这听起来是个好主意，那就劳烦您了。
say:40:1623209040:1.male: That sounds like an excellent idea. We'd be grateful for your help.
say:40:1623209040:1.female: That sounds like an excellent idea. We'd be grateful for your help.

say:41:1623209041:1.text: I only hope it won't take much of your time.
say:41:1623209041:1.source_cn: 希望这不会占用你太多宝贵的时间。
say:41:1623209041:1.male: I only hope it won't take much of your time.
say:41:1623209041:1.female: I only hope it won't take much of your time.

say:43:1623209035:1.text: Naturally. That's what keeps us on our feet... well, I mean, sticks.
say:43:1623209035:1.source_cn: 遵守规矩是立足的根本，我们明白。
say:43:1623209035:1.male: Naturally. That's what keeps us on our feet... well, I mean, sticks.
say:43:1623209035:1.female: Naturally. That's what keeps us on our feet... well, I mean, sticks.

choice:32:0:1.text: I can help, but on one condition.
choice:32:0:1.source_cn: 也许我们可以帮你们，但有个前提
choice:32:0:1.male: I can help, but on one condition.
choice:32:0:1.female: I can help, but on one condition.

say:46:1623209020:1.female: Maybe we should just go back to the Serene Lyceum, Candel...

say:47:1623209021:1.source_cn: 不！请等等！尊敬的魔法师，您的敏锐完全正确！刚才那只是...

say:47:1623209021:1.female: No, please! Honored mage, your discernment is impeccable. That was only a... small joke. One badly phrased! No disrespect intended!

choice:22:1:2.text: Lie again, and I'll take you back.
choice:22:1:2.source_cn: 再骗我就抓你们回去，两个“小逃犯”
choice:22:1:2.male: Lie again, and I'll take you back.
choice:22:1:2.female: Lie again, and I'll take you back.

choice:16:1:2.male: He is a friend of mine.
choice:16:1:2.female: She is a friend of mine.
